title: Update 15.2 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2019 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 15.2 for 2019 Release Wave 2 includes hotfixes and feature changes such as adding Name 2 field to customer and vendor cards, including job information in archived documents, using VAT clauses on different document types, and viewing item availability by unit of measure.
features: Name 2 field on customer and vendor cards
Item availability by unit of measure
